AcceptAllRequest.description:
Which part of the queue to accept, as for ``GET /transactions``. Every field left out
matches everything, so ``{}`` accepts every suggestion waiting for review.
AcceptAllRequest.title: AcceptAllRequest

AccountUpdate.description: The user's edits. Leave a field out to keep it; a blank or null institution clears it.
AccountUpdate.title: AccountUpdate

layout.description: Confirmed column layout as JSON. Required for CSV, refused for OFX.
layout.title: Layout

layout.description: A column layout to read the whole file with, as JSON in the shape POST /imports takes. CSV only. Without it, the engine detects the layout.
layout.title: Layout

CategorySource.description: What assigned a transaction's category. ``USER`` is never overridden automatically.
CategorySource.title: CategorySource

CsvLayoutOut.description:
A CSV layout in exactly the shape ``POST /imports`` takes as ``layout``, except that
``null`` marks a part the user still has to choose. Columns count from 0.
CsvLayoutOut.title: CsvLayoutOut

CsvQuestionKind.description: What the UI must ask before the file can be imported.
CsvQuestionKind.title: CsvQuestionKind

DebitCreditOut.description: Money out and money in sit in separate columns.
DebitCreditOut.title: DebitCreditOut

RuleUpdate.description: Leave a field out to keep its current value.
RuleUpdate.title: RuleUpdate

SignedAmountOut.description: One column holds every amount, negative for money out (unless ``invert_signs``).
SignedAmountOut.title: SignedAmountOut

TransactionUpdate.description: The user's edits. Leave a field out to keep its current value.
TransactionUpdate.title: TransactionUpdate

delete.description: Delete the account with all of its imports and transactions. This can't be undone.

post.description:
Categorize in the background; poll ``GET /categorization/status`` for progress.

A request made while a run is going is combined with any other waiting request into one
next run.

Delete every account, import, transaction and learned setting, leaving a new database.

The body is only validated: anything but `{"confirm": "DELETE"}` is rejected with 422.
Write a copy of the database, a CSV of every transaction and a README to a new folder.

Add a demo checking account and credit card with a year of made-up transactions.

The year ends today. The statements are imported exactly like an uploaded file.

409.description: The demo data was added before

post.description: Store a statement's transactions in an account, skipping ones already stored.

Read a statement without saving anything, and say what the user still has to confirm.

With ``layout``, every row is read with it, so the rows and count match what importing would
store, and a row that doesn't fit is reported as an error naming the row.

Accept the suggested category of each listed transaction: it becomes your choice, leaves
the queue and is remembered for its merchant. Transactions that aren't waiting for review
with a suggestion are skipped and not counted.
Accept every suggestion in the review queue that matches the filters.

get.description:
Every rule in the order they are tried: yours first, then the defaults, each by priority
(highest first) and then the longest pattern first.

post.description:
Add a rule. ``422`` if the pattern can't be used, ``409`` if you already have a rule with
the same pattern.

How many stored transactions a pattern matches, without saving anything. ``422`` with a
readable message if the pattern can't be used.

delete.description: Delete one of your rules. ``403`` for a default rule.

patch.description: Change one of your rules. ``403`` for a default rule.

schema.title: Needs Review

get.description: The dates of the oldest and newest stored transactions, e.g. to bound a month picker.

patch.description:
Edit a transaction. A category set here is yours: automatic categorization never changes
it, and it is remembered for the merchant, so later transactions from it get it too.

get.description:
How many other transactions from this one's merchant would change if its category were
applied to them, e.g. to ask "Apply to all 14 from Blue Bottle?" after a correction.

post.description:
Give this transaction's category to the others from its merchant counted by
``GET .../same-merchant``. Categories you set yourself are never changed.

delete.description:
Unlink two transactions that were wrongly paired as a transfer; returns both, updated.

A side that was in Transfers only because of the link becomes uncategorized and needs
review; a category the user chose stays.

schema.title: Response Delete Transfer Transfers  Transfer Group  Delete
